judged_text: With sharing enabled `tokenInfo` is a fetch Response, which has no `.data` property, so the unchanged `if (!tokenInfo.data.error)` throws a TypeError (reading 'error' of undefined). Bigin token refresh always throws on sharing-enabled deployments, so synced Bigin credentials can never be refreshed and calendar operations fail as soon as the initially synced token expires.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh call was changed to `const tokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)`. When sharing is enabled (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`), `refreshOAuthTokens` returns the result of `fetch(...)`, i.e. a `Response` object, not an Axios response. The subsequent code is unchanged and still does `if (!tokenInfo.data.error) { ... }`, but `Response` has no `.data`, so `tokenInfo.data` is `undefined` and reading `.error` will throw a TypeError. This is directly verifiable from the diff: `refreshOAuthTokens` returns `fetch(...)` and the Bigin code still assumes `.data`.
